 Cameroon – Namibia, in the Africa Cup of Nations qualifiers, takes place on Thursday 12 November 2026 at 19:00 GMT. Of 18 internationals assessed at club level, 3 are in form, 12 steady and 3 struggling.

 The match: Cameroon – Namibia, Africa Cup of Nations qualifiers, Thursday 12 November 2026
 In form: Danny Namaso , Mahamadou Nagida , André Onana 
 Steady: Frank Anguissa , Darlin Yongwa , Etta Eyong , Samuel Kotto , Malcom Bokele and 7 others
 Struggling: Junior Tchamadeu, Junior Dina Ebimbe, Enzo Tchato Mbiayi
 The scope: internationals playing in 15 European competitions; this is not the coach's squad list
 Cameroon, known as the Indomitable Lions, face Namibia on Thursday 12 November 2026 at 19:00 GMT, in the Africa Cup of Nations qualifiers. Ahead of that fixture, the SNA newsroom has reviewed 18 Cameroon internationals playing in the 15 European competitions it follows and who have featured for their clubs since 22 October 2026. The verdict: 3 in form, 12 steady, 3 struggling. The criteria can be summed up in one sentence: two goals or assists, or four starts with an average statistical rating of 7.2 or higher, to be in form; no starts or fewer than 150 minutes to be struggling; everyone else is steady.
 Three Lions in form, from goal to attack
 André Onana played all 450 minutes of Trabzonspor's last 5 matches, from 22 October to 8 November 2026. The goalkeeper has an average statistical rating of 7.4 out of 10, above the 7.2 threshold set by the criteria.
 Danny Namaso, the Auxerre forward, scored 2 goals and provided 1 assist in 5 starts, from 11 October to 7 November 2026. He has 390 minutes in total, with an average statistical rating of 6.8 out of 10.
 Mahamadou Nagida, the Rennes midfielder, put together 5 starts from 22 October to 8 November 2026, amounting to 431 minutes on the pitch. He also added 2 assists, with an average statistical rating of 6.6 out of 10.
 Twelve steady performers, unit by unit
 In defence, Samuel Kotto (Reims) has played every minute: 5 starts, 450 minutes. Malcom Bokele, at Göztepe, also has 450 minutes across his last 5 matches. Flavien Boyomo (Osasuna) started all 4 of his matches, for 360 minutes, while Harold Moukoudi (AEK Athens FC) started 3 games, for 270 minutes. Darlin Yongwa stands out in another way: the Norwich defender scored 1 goal, in 3 starts.

 Key figures
 18 Cameroon internationals reviewed 15 European competitions followed 150 minutes struggling threshold 7.2 rating threshold In midfield, Frank Anguissa (Napoli) scored 1 goal in 5 starts. Simon Ebonog, of Le Havre, accumulated 443 minutes, and Olivier Kemen (Başakşehir) 438. At Lorient, Arthur Avom Ebong started 4 matches, for 372 minutes; Carlos Baleba, at Manchester United, also started 4 times, for 300 minutes.
 Up front, Bryan Mbeumo (Manchester United) was handed 5 starts, for 439 minutes, and Etta Eyong (Levante) scored 1 goal in 3 starts, across his last 4 matches.
 Three Lions struggling, below the 150-minute mark
 Junior Tchamadeu, the Stoke City midfielder, has played only 148 minutes across his last 5 matches, including 4 as a starter.
 Junior Dina Ebimbe (FC Schalke 04, midfielder) totals 147 minutes over 4 matches, with 3 starts.
 Enzo Tchato Mbiayi, the Frosinone defender, was named in the starting line-up 2 times across his last 3 matches, for 126 minutes.
 This form guide covers the Cameroon internationals in the 15 European competitions followed by SNA and is not an indication of the coach's squad list.
